description.value: Family-run specialty British grocery store founded by London-born Andy Bradshaw, claiming to be the largest British grocery store in North America with over 1,400 imported products. Located in Surrey since 2014, it stocks a wide range of imported British food cupboard staples, drinks, sweets, chocolate, crisps, and in-store-only chilled and frozen goods. It also operates as the exclusive wholesaler for GB Foods, a producer of traditional British-style meat products made on-site.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms an active specialty British grocery store at 13369 72nd Ave, Surrey, BC V3W 2N5, with phone (+1) 604 593 2122 and website matching OSM. The store carries 1,400+ imported British food products including drinks, snacks, and food cupboard staples, making 'Basic groceries' supportable for a cycling stop. No website or OSM content mentions bike parking, water bottle refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities, so all such fields remain null. The OSM community tag says 'Tsawwassen' but the website clearly places the store in Surrey — a discrepancy flagged in concerns.
concerns: OSM community field says 'Tsawwassen' but the website clearly states the address is in Surrey, BC — these are distinct municipalities. OSM community tag should be corrected to Surrey.
OSM address lacks city and postal code; website provides the full address: 13369 72nd Ave, Surrey, BC V3W 2N5.
OSM had no phone number on record; phone sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Store is active and carries food and drinks useful to touring cyclists, but neither required criterion (bike parking, water bottle refill) is confirmed from any evidence source. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify cyclist-specific facilities before inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: Store also operates an online shop with nationwide shipping (excluding chocolate in summer). In-store-only items include chilled/fresh and frozen British foods. The about page references a former café (Sherlock's Café & Tea Room, opened 2009) but there is no current evidence this café service is still operating.
